[bug] Incorrect reproduction count when using all_pipelines=True

#### Problem Description

When using `dvc.reproduce()` with `all_pipelines=True`, the function is not correctly collecting all stages to reproduce. This leads to incorrect behavior when trying to reproduce all pipelines in a project.

from dvc.repo import Repo

# Setup a simple project

repo.stage.add(name='echo-bar', deps=['foo'], outs=['bar'], cmd='echo bar > bar')

# This should reproduce all stages but doesn't work correctly

The code should reproduce all 5 stages in the pipeline.

The code fails with an AttributeError because the stages are not being collected correctly when `all_pipelines=True` is specified.
